Optional Server news uses HTTPS to anarchy-online.com, project-rk.com and ao-rebirth.com for your selected sources, refreshing every 15 minutes while visible. Events only: ordinary SyncManager movement events, with no extra refresh traffic. Lowest extra overhead, but gaps between events can allow drift. 5 Hz trial: adds a fresh local movement-state update every 200 ms while moving. May reduce drift; adds client and disk work. 10 Hz trial: every 100 ms, twice the refresh work of 5 Hz. Faster updates are not guaranteed to improve movement. These trials do not raise the server tick rate or fix obstacles, zoning, stalled clients or excessive separation. Formation control temporarily suspends movement sync; attack sync can remain enabled.

Choose the formation leader and transfer actual in-game team leadership. The current leader must be running in Nexus and both characters must be in the same team. Active formation pauses during transfer and resumes only after confirmation.

Follow: followers travel behind the leader. Circle: followers occupy places around the leader. Funny business: followers wander within the radius and perform random emotes. Formation takes over follower movement; obstacles can prevent reaching a place. Funny business tries another direction when blocked.

Follow uses spacing between positions; Circle and Funny business use a radius around the leader. More space reduces crowding but needs more open ground. A small radius can make characters overlap. Stop formation before changing this value.
